# Sanctumd 3.0.1

Nothing changes in the app; this release is 3.0 built again with the groundwork for **F-Droid**.

The build is now reproducible: F-Droid can compile it from source and get a byte-for-byte copy of
the APK on this page. That lets an F-Droid listing ship this same signed APK, so you can move
between GitHub, Obtainium and F-Droid without reinstalling.

- No Google dependency report in the APK any more.
- Store texts, icon and screenshots in `fastlane/metadata`.
- An Obtainium badge in the README installs it and keeps it updated from these releases.

What 3.0 brought is in the [3.0.0 release](https://github.com/Phioster/sanctum_daemon/releases/tag/v3.0.0).

## Install

| | |
|---|---|
| **Phone** | `sanctumd-v3.0.1.apk`, Android 8.0+, 64-bit ARM |
| **Android TV** | `sanctumd-tv-v3.0.1.apk`, a Jellyfin player only |

Updating from 3.0.0 or 2.1.x installs over the old version and keeps your services.
